spawnVectors.name: initial-forced-common
spawnVectors.note: Isolated source-adapter spawn fixture; empty pillar layout is intentional. FNV-1a operates on UTF-16 code units, as existing hashSeed does.

spawnVectors.name: golden-attempt-exhaustion-with-center-free
spawnVectors.note: All64 attempts propose(6,6), outside the center diamond; fallback selects first eligible center cell in z/x row-major order.

spawnVectors.name: golden-center-full-common-fallback
spawnVectors.note: No eligible golden center cell is free; whole-board fallback changes type without additional random draws.

spawnVectors.name: common-attempt-exhaustion
spawnVectors.note: 64 occupied(0,0) attempts, then row-major whole-board fallback.

spawnVectors.name: jittery-attempt-exhaustion
spawnVectors.note: Archetype boundary fixture keeps type jittery after bounded spawn search.

cases.stimulus: Open a URL seed containing , click Start, then finish a run.
cases.expected: Seed appears as literal text; no injected img/script node, probe flag or unexpected request exists.

cases.stimulus: Load records with markup-bearing seed/date/outcome/mode values, then open summary and leaderboard.
cases.expected: Reject invalid fields or render text; never execute stored markup.

cases.stimulus: Open valid UTF-8 seed, empty/control-character/129-code-point seed and rules=999 URLs.
cases.expected: Valid seed round-trips unchanged; invalid input shows fixed fallback status and ordinary Classic play; no truncation or silent challenge-version match.

cases.stimulus: Choose Low, bloom off, AA off and Segments through UI; reload.
cases.expected: Requested values and effective compatible values persist; source and dist agree.

cases.stimulus: Use absent, malformed and storage-throwing settings; select Auto and exercise automatic downgrade.
cases.expected: Usable defaults/session memory; Auto remains requested quality; tuning never saves a manual tier.

cases.stimulus: Toggle Q/B/M/T during gameplay, return to settings, reload.
cases.expected: Settings, keyboard controls and requested persistence agree; graphics do not change run descriptor.

cases.stimulus: Load legacy wrap=true; inspect each mode and switch selected mode while a run is paused.
cases.expected: Mode owns boundaries; wrap is discarded as a preference; mode changes affect the next run only.

cases.stimulus: Open settings during play; press Space, Enter, R and each direction key.
cases.expected: Only native focused control actions occur; no hidden movement or run restart.

cases.stimulus: Tab/Shift-Tab across modal edges, close with Escape, then activate Resume.
cases.expected: Focus remains inside modal while open, restores predictably, and simulation resumes exactly once only on Resume.

cases.stimulus: Set IJKL/HJKL/Arrows/WASD maps; start from title with a permitted direction.
cases.expected: Selected map starts and queues its first legal direction; disallowed map keys do not steer.

cases.stimulus: Open pause/settings; inspect telemetry and activate explicit Restart/Return to title.
cases.expected: Telemetry is current; actions close modal before changing run; no stale callback overwrites the new title/run.

cases.stimulus: Fresh context emulates reduced-motion and prefers-contrast; then change media features.
cases.expected: Missing preferences inherit OS values and media updates; explicit false overrides remain false.

cases.stimulus: Enable in-game reduced motion with OS false; trigger eat/speed/death and render multiple frames.
cases.expected: Shake/CA/grain/FOV kick/Dutch roll/dolly/death push and HUD pop are suppressed; stable camera fit remains.

cases.stimulus: Audit title/settings/pause/summary/leaderboard/error DOM with keyboard and axe.
cases.expected: Names, selected states, focus and status announcements work; no critical/serious menu a11y violation.

cases.stimulus: Switch colorblind/high-contrast modes at each graphics tier and reload.
cases.expected: Prey remains distinguishable by silhouette and palette; text and focus are legible; preference restores.

cases.stimulus: Start, eat common/golden/jittery, pause/resume, die or win, invoke finalize twice.
cases.expected: Exact food/score/length/time/maxima; one immutable summary and at most one record write.

cases.stimulus: Visit title/pause/completed-summary; click Share and Leaderboard using real controls.
cases.expected: Only valid state actions are visible/focusable; both summary actions operate and listeners do not multiply.

cases.stimulus: Restart before delayed death overlay fires, then finish another run.
cases.expected: Old runId timers cannot change current overlay, statistics, records or focus.

cases.stimulus: Force demo pillar/self/trap/target events and run 3000 movement steps across all modes.
cases.expected: Demo cycles; title stays title; no player Game Over, metrics, seed, best, audio or haptics changes.

cases.stimulus: Capture player storage, leave title through multiple demo cycles, then start with a direction.
cases.expected: Player storage is byte-identical; fresh run starts score0/length3 with correct tuple and first direction.

cases.stimulus: Run Frenzy with fixed tuple after 20 varied old second-prey positions and after demo cycles.
cases.expected: Opening snake/prey/pillars/RNG snapshots are identical.

cases.stimulus: Exercise nearly full board, last free cell, tail hand-off, growing tail and Calm seam. Include Frenzy with two prey and one free cell, disabling target victory only through the source-test adapter; verify the exact spawn vectors in required_fixture.spawnVectors.
cases.expected: No occupied spawn/infinite loop; safe tail hand-off works; growing-tail/self/pillar collisions and wrap remain correct. Keep the unspawnable entity inactive without premature win; consume the remaining prey normally; board victory requires snake+pillars filling playable cells.

cases.stimulus: Start today/pinned daily/custom at UTC midnight; use summary Play again and paused Restart after midnight, and switch selected modes before/during a run.
cases.expected: Captured tuple never changes; new today run resolves new UTC date; pinned seed repeats; mode remains explicit. Today-intent Play again/Restart resolves the new date; pinned-date Play again/Restart repeats the original.

cases.stimulus: Replay movement-indexed input traces at 30/60/120 FPS, irregular <=250ms frames and batches across 3 modes x 3 tiers.
cases.expected: Every logical snapshot, RNG count, score, outcome and final metric matches at equal simulation time.

cases.stimulus: Arrange golden consumption at 5999/6000/6001ms and combo eats at deadline-1/deadline/deadline+1.
cases.expected: Golden at expiry gives common points; combo at expiry begins x1; exact windows and event order match DEC04.

cases.stimulus: Pause during golden/combo/hop, resume; arrange simultaneous jittery events and speed increase.
cases.expected: No paused time accrues; prey cannot overlap; hop tie order stable; next movement uses new interval only prospectively.

cases.stimulus: Reload current casual/custom/daily/mode records and attempt duplicate finalization.
cases.expected: Full validated metadata persists; exactly one runId entry; scoped top ten ordering is deterministic.

cases.stimulus: Migrate legacy keys twice, inject malformed/oversized/nonfinite records, and make writes throw.
cases.expected: Legacy originals stay unchanged; migration is idempotent; invalid data rejected; same-session records remain usable.

cases.stimulus: Create 31 daily scopes and >10 custom challenge scopes in each mode, then reload.
cases.expected: Retention applies exactly as DEC06; legacy, custom, daily and casual remain separate.

cases.stimulus: Blur/hide/pagehide during play, advance wall time, return; simulate frame gap >250ms.
cases.expected: Run is paused, audio silent and input cleared; no catch-up or auto-resume; Resume retains logical state.

cases.stimulus: Disable WebGL at startup and exercise context-lost/restored plus failed restore.
cases.expected: Accessible recoverable error for unsupported GPU; successful restore retains state/resources; no exception loop.

cases.stimulus: Synthesize pointer down/move, second pointer, cancel/lostcapture and blur; scroll open settings.
cases.expected: Primary steering at20px works; queue bounded3; pad always clears; second touch cannot steal control; modal scroll works.

cases.stimulus: Use real Start click; test absent/false/rejecting vibrate and fullscreen APIs.
cases.expected: Eligible activated player-only feedback; no haptic warning; unsupported features degrade without breaking play.

cases.stimulus: Play, finish, choose mode, start again; return to title from pause.
cases.expected: No reload needed; selected mode/settings retained; old run safely abandoned; pinned challenge identity is intentional.

cases.stimulus: Read title and How to play in desktop/touch layouts; expand Advanced graphics.
cases.expected: Exact DEC08 player copy present; technical options discoverable but initially collapsed; no forced tutorial.
No horizontal overflow; every action reachable; clipping prevented by bounded vertical scrolling.

cases.stimulus: Inspect settings at844x390 and320x568; synthesize touch scroll and tap close/Done.
cases.expected: 44x44 minimum action targets; close and Done reachable; no canvas interception of modal scroll.

cases.stimulus: Repeat title/pause/summary/leaderboard/settings/error at200% zoom or equivalent text/layout scaling.
cases.expected: Content/controls remain usable; no overlap or lost actions; safe-area/HUD contracts hold.

cases.stimulus: Copy a daily/custom card and open its link in fresh storage under /just-snake/.
cases.expected: Concrete seed/mode/rules preserved; same opening challenge; no root-relative asset fetch.

cases.stimulus: Deny clipboard; click Share; inspect fallback and local/session leaderboard labels.
cases.expected: Complete readonly selectable card is available; accessible status; On this device/session-only saving accurately described.

cases.stimulus: Exercise score thresholds and speed floor for all modes with previous best0 and positive best.
cases.expected: Levels cap15/16/13, MAX only at floor, progress0..1 and record state reset/eligibility correct.

cases.stimulus: Eat 9/10/19/20/29/30/39/40 prey with varied points/combos; restart and run demo.
cases.expected: Zone is min(4,floor(eatCount/10)); demo has independent counter; player restart returns zone0.

cases.stimulus: Capture shadow-pass draw calls and identity at length3/20/60/441 and each body mode/tier.
cases.expected: <=3 contact-shadow draws, stable preallocated buffers, correct active ranges, no logical changes.

cases.stimulus: Dispatch100 resizes in one frame; repeat100 resize/tier/restart cycles.
cases.expected: At most1 resize rebuild per frame, final dimensions correct, retained resources bounded.

cases.stimulus: Emit particles, expire all, observe120 idle frames, emit again.
cases.expected: Zero idle scans/uploads, correct active pool restart, no lost burst.

cases.stimulus: Measure length3/20/60 mode/tier resources and native/SwiftShader timings; compare against same-run baseline.
cases.expected: Structural budgets hold; no >10% median or >15% p95 regression on same capable hardware without justified accepted improvement; no fabricated hardware claim.

cases.stimulus: Build twice; compare payload digests; inspect every emitted path, symlink and reference.
cases.expected: Identical output, approved allowlist only, no external runtime dependency, no secrets/debug pages, budgets pass. Production globals contain no mutable test adapter; the uploaded path set cannot differ because of dotfile exclusions.

cases.stimulus: Inspect metadata/favicon/social capture/notices/README and all derived public URLs.
cases.expected: Exact product facts, local assets/valid dimensions/licenses; no placeholders or invented owner/license. Repository/page/share/social naming is exactly just-snake.

cases.expected: Required local commands/cases are explicit; injected nonzero status prevents the modeled deploy path; no PR privilege. Report hosted_run_not_executed until E05 proves an actual successful run.

cases.stimulus: Inspect workflow permissions, action pins, needs, concurrency and uploaded artifact identity.
cases.expected: Pinned reviewed SHAs; minimum scopes; exact checked dist only; existing environment protection preserved.

cases.stimulus: Search authoritative and legacy documents for constants/statuses/dead script references.
cases.expected: No conflicting current rules/DONE claims; V11 present; legacy exceptions explicit; evidence links resolve.

cases.stimulus: Discover real GitHub state; execute authorized same-name publication or simulate missing access.

cases.stimulus: Verify live candidate bytes and startup; use the already qualified local rollback rehearsal evidence. Perform actual production rollback only if update verification fails and an authorized known-good artifact exists.
cases.expected: A successful candidate stays live and is marked published only after verification. Failed candidates remain failed even if recovery succeeds; rolled_back identifies the previous active digest. No routine rollback silently replaces a successful candidate.
